title: Third GTA 6 Video Leaks Online Amid Rockstar Removal Efforts
description: A third seemingly real GTA 6 gameplay video has leaked online, bearing the CyberLeek watermark as Rockstar scrambles to remove the footage across the internet.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Another GTA 6 Leak Surfaces as Rockstar Steps Up Content Removal

As the anticipation surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to reach fever pitch, the title has once again found itself at the center of an unexpected leak. According to a recent report by gaming outlet Eurogamer, a third video featuring what appears to be legitimate Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay has emerged online.

### The CyberLeek Connection and Spreading Footage

This latest leak does not appear to be an isolated incident. Much like the earlier leaks from the same day, this newly surfaced video bears the watermark of a group reportedly connected to the ongoing breach, identified as CyberLeek. As the footage began circulating across various digital platforms and community spaces, it quickly caught the attention of gamers and industry watchers alike, sparking fresh discussions about the game's current development state.

### Rockstar's Swift Response to Protect Content

In response to the sudden wave of unauthorized footage, Rockstar Games has reportedly scrambled to purge the material from the internet. The developer is actively working to remove the leaked videos wherever they appear. Given the immense scale of the project and the strict security measures typically enforced by the studio, combating these leaks remains a top priority to protect the integrity of the game's official marketing pipeline.

### Analysis and Industry Context

(Analysis) Experiencing leaks of this magnitude is a notorious hurdle for major game developers. While these unverified clips offer a brief glimpse into the project, they rarely reflect the polish of a finished product. Gamers are advised to approach such material with caution and rely on official updates from Rockstar for an accurate representation of the title.

## Editor's Take

These ongoing leaks highlight the difficult security environment major studios face during development. While the temptation to watch leaked footage is strong, it hurts the development team and spoils the intended reveal. We should respect Rockstar's work and wait for official announcements.
